sm_top.sm: Ukrainian strikes using missiles and drones severely damaged the Kerch Bridge in Crimea.
Tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz following attacks and mine strikes, prompting international condemnation.
A third US aircraft carrier has arrived in the Middle East amid regional tensions.
Iran conducted a drone strike targeting a US radar system at a Bahrain air base.
Saudi-backed forces retreated from strategic positions near Bab el-Mandeb following Houthi advances.
An Israeli airstrike in Gaza killed a senior Hamas commander.
Russian ballistic missile strikes hit Kyiv's Southern and Northern bridges, causing damage across districts.
Iran launched drones targeting a US radar system at a Bahrain air base.
Iran claims to have shot down or captured a US drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed Houthi drones launched toward the Makkah and Riyadh regions.
Iranian forces claim to have shot down a US drone south of Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthi forces advanced to within 60 km of Aden as Yemeni government forces retreated and bolstered defenses.
Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least six people and injured 88 others, with the EU accusing Moscow of prolonging the war.
US fighter jets struck an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island following an attack in Bahrain.
Hungary halts rail services with Ukraine for two days following a Russian drone attack on the Zakarpattia region.
Russia attacked Dnipro and the surrounding region nearly 20 times with missiles and drones.
A Sudanese army airstrike killed 15 people, including children, in West Kordofan.
Ukrainian forces struck Akhtubinsk Airfield, leaving a runway on fire.
Mass Russian attacks injured more than 40 people in Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia.
The Myanmar military bombed an IDP camp in Ponnagyun Township, killing at least 13 people.
A whistleblower alleges leaders ignored warnings before an Iranian drone strike in Kuwait killed six US soldiers.
Iran conducted a drone strike targeting a US radar system at a Bahrain air base while regional forces intercepted incoming attacks.
Moscow targeted bridges in Kyiv with overnight strikes during a massive attack.
A section of the Crimean Bridge collapsed into the Kerch Strait following an overnight Ukrainian strike.
Russia launched a massive attack against Ukraine using missiles and hundreds of drones.
Ukrainian long-range drones struck a major petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, Russia.
Russian airstrike on a Komyshuvakha aid center killed 72 people, with search operations concluding.
Russian strikes hit Ukrainian cities, killing at least five and cutting power across multiple regions.
An overnight Russian attack on Kyiv left two people killed and one wounded.
President Zelenskyy stated that Ukrainian drone attacks have neutralized over 55 percent of Russia's oil refining capacity.
Tankers were struck and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz.
A Russian military transport plane crashed in Siberia, resulting in 19 deaths.
TASS reports that Ukraine conducted one of the largest overnight UAV attacks on Moscow in two years.
A third American aircraft carrier arrived in the Middle East.
Russian Ministry of Defence claims its Vostok group of forces captured the settlement of Zalivne in Zaporizhzhia Oblast.
Russian forces launched a large-scale drone attack on western Ukraine.
Reports indicate Iran destroyed a fully-laden LNG tanker in the Gulf, with the crew believed to have perished.
The UN reported that drones accounted for nearly three-quarters of Sudan war deaths this year.
Russian strikes hit a bridge in Zaporizhzhia and bridges in Kyiv, resulting in civilian casualties in both cities.
Russia reported a massive, multi-day Ukrainian drone attack across its territory.
